screenLevelIssues.figmaValue: Legends aligned with specific columns (JAN, FEB, MAR)
screenLevelIssues.currentValue: Legends in separate row with gap: 10
screenLevelIssues.explanation: The chart legends ('on time', 'Paid late', 'Not Paid') are rendered in a separate container with a fixed gap of 10px. In the design, these labels are aligned with the specific chart columns (JAN, FEB, MAR) which have a pitch of 40px (24px width + 16px gap). The current implementation causes the legends to drift and misalign with the data bars.
The vertical dividers between chart columns are rendered as solid lines. The Figma design clearly shows dashed lines.
screenLevelIssues.currentCode:
chartColumnDivider: {
  position: 'absolute',
  right: -CHART_GAP / 2 - 0.25,
  top: 0,
  bottom: 0,
  width: 0.5,
  backgroundColor: PROFILE_COLORS.divider,
},
screenLevelIssues.fixedCode:
chartColumnDivider: {
  position: 'absolute',
  right: -CHART_GAP / 2,
  top: 0,
  bottom: 0,
  width: 1,
  borderLeftWidth: 1,
  borderColor: PROFILE_COLORS.divider,
  borderStyle: 'dashed',
},
